review.tagline: WXT and React browser extension starter with Supabase auth and AI
review.summary: Bun-based WXT project for Chrome (MV3) and Firefox (MV2) with every entrypoint (popup, side panel, devtools, new tab, options, content) preconfigured, Supabase OAuth shared across pages, storage, messaging, i18n, OpenPanel analytics, shadcn/ui, Biome, unit tests and a publish workflow. Native AI integration is marked experimental. For teams shipping a React extension with accounts; billing is marked coming soon.
review.audience: Teams building a React browser extension with accounts and AI
strengths: All extension entrypoints wired, including side panel and devtools
Auth session and storage shared between popup, content and options pages
CI publishing to Chrome Web Store and Firefox Add-ons
Plasmo variant maintained on a separate branch
weaknesses: AI integration is marked experimental and thinly documented in the README
Billing is listed as coming soon
Firefox builds target MV2 and load only in temporary mode
needs: TypeScript, Vercel AI SDK, browser built-in AI (experimental)
